CustomField.description: Total amount (principal + interest + tax) at posting time.
CustomField.formula: IF(ISBLANK(Principal_Amount__c), 0, Principal_Amount__c) + IF(ISBLANK(Interest_Amount__c), 0, Interest_Amount__c) + IF(ISBLANK(Tax_Amount__c), 0, Tax_Amount__c)
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Sums principal, interest, and tax components so you can see the total impact of the ledger row.
CustomField.label: Total Amount
